column1: # Headphones with their own EQ presets: copy to headphones.local.tsv (not in the repo) and list your own. build-presets
# makes the presets from AutoEq measurements (github.com/jaakkopasanen/AutoEq, results/INDEX.md lists them).
#   name     part of the headphones' Bluetooth name (e.g. "AirPods Pro" matches "Jari's AirPods Pro"); also the presets' prefix
#   result   AutoEq result (results/<this>) with noise cancelling on, or the only measurement
#   Mode=…   optional: other listening modes, e.g. Transparency=… and Passive=… (noise cancelling off); the headphones
#            menu then lists Noise cancelling and these under Listening mode, and the EQ follows the one picked
# (examples above: remove the '# ' in your copy)
